# slack_app_icon (Resource)

Sets the icon of a Slack app with `apps.icon.set`.

Needs `app_configuration_token` in the provider configuration. Slack accepts a
square image between 512 and 2000 pixels on each side. Set exactly one of `file` or `url`.

Slack has no method that reads an app icon, so this resource cannot detect an
icon changed outside Terraform. Refresh keeps the state as it is. To restore the
icon, change `sha256` or `url`, or replace the resource.

Slack has no method that removes an app icon. Destroying this resource only removes
it from state, and the app keeps its current icon.

`apps.icon.set` is a Tier 1 method, so Slack may rate limit repeated changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "slack_app_icon" "from_file" {
  app_id = slack_app.workspace.id
  file   = "${path.module}/icon.png"
  sha256 = filesha256("${path.module}/icon.png")
}

resource "slack_app_icon" "from_url" {
  app_id = "A0123456789"
  url    = "https://example.com/icon.png"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) The ID of the app, e.g. `A012ABCD0A0`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `file` (String) The path of the image to upload. Slack takes a PNG, JPEG or GIF image between 512 and 2000 pixels on each side. Needs `sha256`. Conflicts with `url`.
- `sha256` (String) The hash of the image `file`, from `filesha256(path)`. A new hash uploads the icon again. Needs `file`.
- `url` (String) The URL of the image for Slack to download. Conflicts with `file`. Changing it uploads the icon again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of this resource.
